title: Acoustic reflection at an impedance step, density sweep (analytic)
description:
A plane Ricker pressure pulse (normal traction sheet, 1 MHz) in a y-periodic fluid strip (rho1 = 1000, c1 = 1480) hits fluid 2 (c2 = 2500, density rho2 swept 250..8000 kg/m^3) at normal incidence at x = 20 mm, a cell edge (elastic_waves, absorbing x faces).
Analytic: pressure reflection R = (Z2 - Z1) / (Z2 + Z1), transmission T = 2 Z2 / (Z2 + Z1), Z = rho c; the incident pulse is p = (T_sheet / 2) w(t - 4/f0 - d / c1), w the Ricker wavelet.
Sweep tab: R_matched and T_matched (matched filter: the probe trace projected on the Ricker wavelet at the predicted arrival, over its energy) against the dashed R(rho2), T(rho2); R changes sign at rho2 = Z1 / c2 = 592.
Probes tab (last sweep value, rho2 = 2000): acoustics.incident (incident pulse + reflected echo) and acoustics.transmitted with the dashed analytic traces; their FFTs against the Ricker spectrum (incident: |1 + R exp(-j 2 pi f dt)| interference ripple).
Line profile tab: p_profile, the reflected pulse at t_end.
Derived values tab: inc_matched (should be 1), R_matched, T_matched; expected < 1 % (O((k dx)^2) at 47 cells per shortest wavelength).

parameters.name: t_d
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum at the sheet

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak normal traction of the sheet in Pa

parameters.name: p_half
parameters.description: pressure amplitude of each plane wave the sheet launches

parameters.name: c1
parameters.description: sound speed of fluid 1 in m/s

parameters.name: c2
parameters.description: sound speed of fluid 2 in m/s

parameters.name: Z1
parameters.description: acoustic impedance of fluid 1 in Pa s/m

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probes and the profile line (a cell centre)

parameters.name: t_inc
parameters.description: incident pulse centre time at the incident probe

parameters.name: t_refl
parameters.description: reflected pulse centre time at the incident probe

parameters.name: E_ric
parameters.description: Ricker energy: integral of w^2 dt in s

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration (the reflected pulse has passed the incident probe)

analytic_curves.name: p_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < x_I, p_half*R_ref*(1 - 2*(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - (2*x_I - x_s - x)/c1))**2)*exp(-(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - (2*x_I - x_s - x)/c1))**2), 0)
